name: eazy-school-360-firebase
description: Firebase deployment and security rules management for Eazy School 360

scripts.deploy-all: npm run deploy-rules && npm run deploy-indexes && firebase deploy
scripts.start: npm run deploy-rules && flutter run -d chrome
scripts.build: npm run deploy-rules && flutter build web --release
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting

author: Eazy School 360 Team
